howto: Press Play. The valley pans past on its own: there is nothing to win or lose.
Drag the view, or use the arrows, to look around. Freeze, slow down or speed up time with the control bar.
The chronicle notes real moments as they happen. Tick off all ten kinds in Sightings.
Press END to see what this session saw, then start a new day or keep watching.
tips: Speed time up to 4x to bring the V-flock and a full lap round sooner.
Keep the pond on screen to catch its glint, and more rarely its dead calm.
A cloud crossing the sun happens in the top right: watch the sun.
The world is the same every visit (seed 1337), so a moment you missed will come round again.
Your clock, camera and speed are saved, so the valley picks up where you left it.

controls.keyboard: Space freezes time, , and . change speed, [ and ] scrub time, left and right arrows pan, C shows or hides the chronicle. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag the valley to pan. The bottom bar has pan, freeze, slower, faster, Sightings and END.

difficulty: No difficulty setting: nothing can be lost or failed. The only pacing knob is time speed (0.25x to 4x), which decides how quickly rare moments come round.

cheats.effect: Two new time speeds, 8x and 16x, and time jumps to 8x
Twice as many fireflies in the meadow
Every sighting is ticked in the journal

features.autosave: The chronicle and sightings save the moment they happen; the world clock, camera and speed save every 5 seconds and resume on your next visit
features.goals-or-quests: Sightings: ten kinds of moment to witness, each ticked the first time it happens, with a hint for the next one
features.day-time-ui: The HUD shows the lap of the world, the world clock and the time speed; the control bar freezes or speeds time
features.inventory: The Sightings journal (the star button) lists what you have seen, and the chronicle keeps the last 60 moments with timestamps
features.results: END shows a session summary: world time watched, moments noted, new sightings, then New day or Keep watching
features.tutorial: Three coach marks on the first Play: watching, the time controls and the chronicle; replay from How to play
